final: REFUSE — The 400 N load creates an unresisted 76 N·m moment about the free hinge, so the arm cannot remain in static equilibrium; validation confirms free rotation about z (R003).

spec.name: Hinged support arm

supports.note: Ideal free revolute hinge. At h=1 mm, the 0.1 mm selection radius selects only the hinge-axis nodes (x=10,y=20); it is a mesh selection tolerance, not a pin diameter. All translations of axis nodes restrained; rotation about z remains free.

loads.note: 400 N total downward (-y), distributed across the full z thickness and y=15..25 mm at x=200 mm.

spec.description: Arm with a single ideal free revolute hinge along z at x=10 mm, y=20 mm; no other supports. Hinge represented by translational constraints on its axis, leaving rotation about z free. Downward 400 N total force on x=200 mm, y=15..25 mm, z=0..20 mm. Steel assumed isotropic linear elastic, E=210 GPa and nu=0.3. Static equilibrium must be checked; the specified load creates an unresisted moment about the hinge.
